description: A Minecraft Mod: Player health progression

releases.notes:
# Changelog - Fixed a bug where flint tools were inferred as stone tools. - Fixed a bug where all players' max health would be synced incorrectly as one. - Changed **Life Crystal** ore distribution to **uniform** and increased the chunk distribution for the stone variant. ___
